brief: A utensil holder with two bins that is waterproof and dishwasher safe.

requirements.evidence: Two adjacent cells (piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full) with connector, each holding a bin for utensils; props fork and spoon demonstrate use.
bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full – two full-depth bins placed side-by-side.

Configurator checks fit/collision only; parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material. No waterproofing, sealing, or material certification is verified. Shape provides containment but cannot be claimed waterproof.
Dishwasher safety depends on chosen filament/material, print settings, and temperature resistance, which the configurator does not verify. Cannot be marked met.

finish.summary: Built 2-cell holder with two full-depth bins (810g estimate) demonstrating utensil storage with fork/spoon props. Waterproof and dishwasher-safe claims relate to material/heat/chemical resistance not verified by configurator, so marked unmet.

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.

- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
